scripts.dev: npm run build:client && concurrently -k -n client,worker "npm:watch:client" "wrangler dev"
scripts.db:seed:local: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute meze --local --file=.wrangler/seed-all.sql
scripts.db:reset:local: rm -rf .wrangler/state && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
scripts.db:seed:remote: npm run seed:build && wrangler d1 execute meze --remote --file=.wrangler/seed-all.sql
